create_skill_policy: create a SkillPolicy instance with config, action space, and batch size for hierarchical RL skills
implement_internal_act: implement the abstract _internal_act method in a SkillPolicy subclass to return PolicyActionData
override_is_skill_done: override _is_skill_done in a SkillPolicy subclass to return a BoolTensor indicating skill completion
apply_pddl_postconditions: call set_pddl_problem to configure PDDL actions then use _apply_postcond to modify termination actions
review_skill_policy_termination: review SkillPolicy should_terminate to understand how skills decide when to return control to the high-level policy
